content: Kiara Sen contacted insurance agent Vikram Singh to confirm that her new personal property limit of $150,000 was active. She also inquired about coverage for newly purchased electronics, specifically a $1,200 laptop bought on September 15. Vikram confirmed that electronics are covered up to $5,000 if listed on the schedule, and instructed Kiara to send the laptop's receipt so it could be added. Kiara agreed to send the receipt and concluded the chat.

action_items: Kiara Sen to send the receipt for the new $1,200 laptop
Vikram Singh to update the policy schedule once the receipt is received
